values.description: Measurements in time order. Bind to your sample data.

subgroupSize.description: 1 = Individuals & Moving Range; 2–10 = X-bar & R on consecutive subgroups.

showUCL.description: Show the Upper Control Limit (UCL) markline.

showLCL.description: Show the Lower Control Limit (LCL) markline.

showCenterLine.description: Show the Center Line (process mean) markline.

showMRChart.description: Show the MR (or R) chart below the main chart.

showRunRules.description: Highlight points that violate Western Electric rules 1 and 4.

title.description: Chart title. Leave blank for the default title.

option.description: Advanced override. When non-empty, this ECharts option replaces the generated chart and the domain props are ignored.

theme.description: Name of a registered ECharts theme. Built-in themes: IgnitionIndustrialDark, IgnitionIndustrialLight. Leave empty for the ECharts default theme.

renderer.description: Rendering engine: canvas (better perf) or svg (better quality/export).

autoResize.description: Automatically resize chart when container dimensions change.

resizeDebounceMs.description: Debounce interval in milliseconds for resize events.

notMerge.description: If true, setOption will not merge with previous option but replace entirely.

lazyUpdate.description: If true, chart update is deferred for better performance during rapid changes.

showLoading.description: Show the built-in ECharts loading animation.

loadingOptions.description: Options for the loading animation (text, color, etc.).

sanitizeTooltip.description: Sanitises HTML in tooltip formatters and blocks non-http(s) links.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible label announced by screen readers.

maps.description: Map definitions for map and geo series, keyed by map name. Each value is a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, or an object with an `svg` string. Set series.map (or geo.map) to the key.
